# Code Bench

> Local-first browser studio for generating, styling, scanning and exporting QR codes and barcodes.

Code Bench runs at https://codebench.trfny.com/. User content is processed in the browser and is not uploaded to a Code Bench backend.

## Main capabilities

- Generate and style QR codes.
- Generate Code 128, EAN, Data Matrix, Aztec, PDF417 and other barcode formats.
- Scan QR codes and barcodes with local files or the browser camera where supported.
- Export generated codes in common image and vector formats.

## Public pages

- [Application](https://codebench.trfny.com/): Code Bench interface.
- [Source](https://github.com/trvny/trvny/tree/main/benches/codebench): application source.
